headline: Cedarville overtake Thomas More at the top
dek: Cedarville won at Northwood on Saturday and now lead the table, all nine of their wins this season coming in conference play. They have scored twenty-two goals and conceded twenty in all matches, and Lake Erie, who won at Ohio Dominican the same day, sit close behind.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is level across the upper half and falls away at the foot: Lake Erie's twenty-eight are more than Northwood and Ohio Dominican have scored together.

wire.line: Cedarville and Lake Erie, close at the top, both still have to play Tiffin, beaten twice all season.

findings.text: Nick Cherry has kept eight clean sheets for Tiffin.

last_match.line: Cedarville have won every match since losing at home to Kentucky Wesleyan; Northwood have gone without a win since beating Ashland.

next_match.line: The hosts' only meeting with a G-MAC side so far gave Ohio Dominican their only win of the season; Ashland come off a heavy defeat at Findlay.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
